title: Route `rcf verify` through the same dispatcher as the alias bin
description: A consumer running the unified `rcf` CLI can reach the adversarial ship-gate verifier as `rcf verify <verb>` and get identical behaviour to the legacy `rcf-verify <verb>` invocation. The legacy bin remains available and emits a one-line deprecation notice on stderr so scripts can be migrated at their own pace.
asA: consumer of the RCF Lite CLI
iWant: to invoke the verify suite as `rcf verify <verb>` inside the unified CLI
soThat: verify sits inside the same verb space as the rest of the RCF chain and I only have to install one package

acceptanceCriteria.description: The `rcf` bin exposes `verify` as a top-level subcommand routed to the same dispatcher as the `rcf-verify` alias bin
acceptanceCriteria.given: the unified `rcf` binary imported from bin/rcf.js
acceptanceCriteria.when: `verify` is looked up on the top-level SUBCOMMANDS map
acceptanceCriteria.then: the handler resolves to the same `main` function that bin/rcf-verify.js exports and dispatches over run/report/provision/cleanup/mcp/help

acceptanceCriteria.description: The top-level `rcf --help` output advertises `verify` as an available subcommand
acceptanceCriteria.then: the printed usage lists `verify <verb>` alongside the other top-level commands

acceptanceCriteria.description: The `rcf-verify` alias bin emits a one-line stderr deprecation notice when invoked directly and stays fully functional
acceptanceCriteria.given: the `rcf-verify` alias bin invoked as the entry point (isMain)
acceptanceCriteria.when: the entry point runs without RCF_QUIET
acceptanceCriteria.then: a single line describing the deprecation and the `rcf verify` replacement is written to stderr before dispatch, and the dispatch itself is unchanged
